title: Infinite Scrolling (Standard)
description: Today I am going to indulge an obsession of yours. Go grab your phone, tablet or sit at the computer screen. Open your favorite website(s). Then get ready to condition yourself to beautiful women. Keep scrolling, looking through these images of gorgeous women. Watch them roll past on your screen. Their beautiful faces, their exquisite bodies, their lewd poses. You want to look. They want you to look. I want you to look. Let’s do this together. You and me. I know you want this. You do, don’t you? Scroll through a site for me. Work your finger, stroke it, make the beautiful women roll by. There are so many to choose from. Blondes, red heads, brunettes and raven beauties. Keep looking, keep searching. Until you find one that’s looking at you just right. Now imagine her before you and keep listening on loop.
author: Mistress Shibby
